messages:
anya: quick check before I send back to the customer — below are the draft answers for SOC2/encryption/subprocessors/log redaction. can someone sanity-check and flag anything missing?

kevin: encryption — in transit: TLS 1.2+ (we recommend TLS 1.3 where supported). at rest: AES-256. keys: hosted uses Redwood-managed AWS KMS by default; Private/Dedicated customers can provide a customer-managed KMS (BYOK). all key operations are logged to CloudTrail.

olivia: rotation detail: CMKs are rotated automatically (annual rotation). customers can also trigger rotation for BYOK keys. we log key usage to audit logs and keep that for 365d by default.

sam: subprocessors — current list we include for questionnaires: AWS (EC2, S3, KMS), Cloudflare (CDN/DNS), Datadog (metrics/tracing), Sentry (error monitoring), Google Workspace (email/collab), Stripe (billing/payments). we should attach the live subprocessors CSV to the response.

kevin: logs/redaction — we have automated scrubbing for common secret patterns and PII in request paths and bodies. example scrub rule we use to detect token-like strings or card numbers: ```regex: /(sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,})|(\b\d{13,19}\b)/g``` matches are replaced with `<REDACTED>`. retention defaults: 30d metrics, 90d traces, 365d audit logs (these are configurable in contracts).

olivia: access control — prod log access requires an access request ticket + approval from oncall and security. access is time-limited, role-scoped, and audited. for support sessions we use scoped, read-only session tokens.

security-bot: FYI docs updated: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/subprocessors (last edited 2025-11-02) :link: 

anya: thanks — any objections to sending this wording to the customer as-is? i'll attach the subprocessors CSV and a short SOC2 scope note (hosted control plane + hosted API in scope; Dedicated/Private noted as separate), plus contact for access requests.

kevin: LGTM. call out that Dedicated instances by default have separate telemetry settings and are not covered by hosted SOC2 unless customer opts in/contracted.

sam: +1, also add security-ops@redwood.com as the contact for access requests.

anya: perfect — i'll send in ~30m and paste the thread here. :thumbsup:
